GET /accounts/{account_id}/infrastructur.description:
Lists and sorts an account’s targets. Filters are optional and are ANDed
together.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname of a target

parameters.name: hostname_contains
parameters.description: Partial match to the hostname of a target

parameters.name: virtual_network_id
parameters.description: Private virtual network identifier of the target

parameters.name: ip_v4
parameters.description: IPv4 address of the target

parameters.name: ip_v6
parameters.description: IPv6 address of the target

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Date and time at which the target was created before (inclusive)

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Date and time at which the target was created after (inclusive)

parameters.name: modified_before
parameters.description: Date and time at which the target was modified before (inclusive)

parameters.name: modified_after
parameters.description: Date and time at which the target was modified after (inclusive)

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description:
Filters for targets that have any of the following IP addresses. Specify
`ips` multiple times in query parameter to build list of candidates.

parameters.name: target_ids
parameters.description:
Filters for targets that have any of the following UUIDs. Specify
`target_ids` multiple times in query parameter to build list of
candidates.

parameters.name: ip_like
parameters.description:
Filters for targets whose IP addresses look like the specified string.
Supports `*` as a wildcard character

parameters.name: ipv4_start
parameters.description:
Defines an IPv4 filter range's starting value (inclusive). Requires
`ipv4_end` to be specified as well.

parameters.name: ipv4_end
parameters.description:
Defines an IPv4 filter range's ending value (inclusive). Requires
`ipv4_start` to be specified as well.

parameters.name: ipv6_start
parameters.description:
Defines an IPv6 filter range's starting value (inclusive). Requires
`ipv6_end` to be specified as well.

parameters.name: ipv6_end
parameters.description:
Defines an IPv6 filter range's ending value (inclusive). Requires
`ipv6_start` to be specified as well.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Current page in the response

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Max amount of entries returned per page

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The field to sort by.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The sorting direction.
